title: Writing: What I Will Do If I Pass My Exams
writingModel: My name is Kamila and I have three big exams next month. I am excited and a little nervous.
If I pass all my exams, I will celebrate with my family. We will have a special dinner at home. If I get a high score in English, I will feel very proud.
If I fail one exam, I won't give up. I will study harder and try again. I always say: if something is difficult, it just means I need more time.
If I do well this semester, I will apply for the WKU scholarship next year. That is my biggest dream. If I get the scholarship, I will study in a partner university abroad.
So — wish me luck! If I work hard, I know I will succeed.
